column2: [intro]
I’ve never learned a thing, but it feels so right,
Music for me is a grand delight.
I’m no Pavarotti or Céline Dion,
But when I sing, it’s a fusion that's on.
In my melodies, there’s a crazy charm,
I sing off-key, but my fans stay calm.
I’m the musical fraud, the king of discord,
Listen to me, I’m the king of the off-key accordion chord.
My singing teacher said, “My little lad,
You sound like a pot, and that’s quite bad.”
But I don’t care, I’ve got my own flair,
No one understands why I’m met with cheers and flair.
In my melodies, there’s a crazy charm,
I sing off-key, but my fans stay calm.
I’m the musical fraud, the king of discord,
Listen to me, I’m the king of the off-key accordion chord.
[ solo ]
So sing along with me, or rather, sing against,
We don’t care about perfect, it’s the joy that makes sense.
Music is a party, a joyful endless spree,
And I’m the artist who sings off-key but brings glee.
[outro]
